research_object: A pre-retrieval policy manager that selects a legal subset of MP, MS, ME, and RS before a fixed downstream generator writes the response.

sees: current visible user text and bounded visible dialogue
runtime-valid session summary when genuinely available
component availability, count, age, and deterministic expected cost
must_not_see: specific retrieved item or card identity/text before the action is selected

step2_fixed_stack: retrieve and filter only components enabled by Step1
realize zero-hit or filtered-off components honestly
use the same frozen generator and prompt compiler to write the response

opportunity_layer.estimand: Whether a real, admissible resource opportunity exists before outcome generation.
opportunity_layer.supervision: Outcome-blind structural labels or audited transparent rules.
opportunity_layer.role: A condition or deterministic gate, never a realized-benefit label.

quality_effect_heads.estimand: P(material immediate support-quality benefit from adding one component | pre-action state, real opportunity, treatment realized).
quality_effect_heads.unit: Independent dialogue/user group with a matched single-component pair.
quality_effect_heads.loss: Group-weighted binary cross-entropy with L2 regularization.

atomic_risk_heads.estimand: P(one named material interaction-or-grounding risk event | applicable completed response).
atomic_risk_heads.rule: Each risk is retained separately; N/A, abstain, and insufficient evidence are not zero-risk labels.
atomic_risk_heads.fallback: If either event or non-event support is insufficient, use a deterministic guard or report INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.

cost.estimand: Actual incremental retrieval calls, injected items, provider input/output tokens, and available USD/latency.
cost.rule: Cost is deterministic accounting and a selector constraint, not a learned reward and not a quality label.

order: any applicable risk constraint fails -> off
cost or global budget fails -> off
compose qualified component bits into one of the 16 legal actions

minimum_data_and_capacity_guards.cross_validation: Dialogue/user-grouped out-of-fold; all scaling and optional projection fit inside the training fold.
minimum_data_and_capacity_guards.model_selection: Beat the prevalence-only probability baseline on both log-loss and Brier; apply a one-standard-error preference for the smaller model.
minimum_data_and_capacity_guards.anti_collapse: OOF must produce both on and off, each in at least four independent groups and at least 10 percent of applicable groups.
minimum_data_and_capacity_guards.tie_rule: Materially equivalent is off; measurement uncertainty or unresolved disagreement is unknown and excluded from supervised loss.

rs_specific_corrections.bank: Use the frozen definition-only six-card development Bank with source responses removed; AM14 routine stop/thanks is runtime-disabled, leaving five active opportunity moves.
rs_specific_corrections.retrieval: Use the corrected lexical family-gated Top-1 runtime for V1.5. BAAI is not promoted as the RS ranker or PM feature.
rs_specific_corrections.wave1_role: The 32-pair six-card run is a conditional direct-effect pilot and training-design diagnostic, not evidence that the full Step1 PM failed.
rs_specific_corrections.wave2_role: No response generation until this corrected preflight passes. The old wave2 prediction freeze may remain only as a secondary prospective diagnostic of the already failed 22-feature composite candidate.

superseded_primary_artifacts.reason: 22 features for 32 groups violates the frozen capacity guard and the model collapses quality, risk, and opportunity-conditional routing into one hard target.
Frozen before the causal-target re-audit; retained as history and secondary prospective diagnosis only.

paid_execution_policy.corrected_minimal_supplement: At most 16 new independent clean pairs may be planned after the data-collection gate passes; this is distinct from confirming the failed wave1 candidate.
paid_execution_policy.unlock_condition: The data-collection half of a fresh zero-API preflight passes, a corrected multi-select atomic-risk packet is frozen, and a new minimal-supplement call identity is separately reviewed.
forbidden_shortcuts: adding BAAI after observing wave1 labels
pooling heterogeneous historical RS rounds as independent training rows
treating each pair outcome as an individually predictable treatment effect without repeated pre-action cells
changing threshold, features, or target after seeing wave2 outcomes
calling an unidentified independent reviewer human gold
